title: ccc models: engine + released columns shipped
context: dec_207f9be652 was a thin stray record from a tool fault during the ccc spawn/models session; the actual follow-ups are now implemented.
decision: ccc models rows lead with the engine name and include a released column derived client-side from dated id suffixes (-YYYYMMDD or -YYYY-MM-DD); no release-date data source exists in any engine catalog, so undated ids render blank.
alternatives_rejected: server-side fetcher scraping Anthropic's overview/deprecations pages — neither publishes release dates (only cutoffs and retirement dates)
